tasks.title: Fix generate-daily-brief.py — stop overwriting curated strategic-context.md
tasks.description: MODIFY ONE FILE: scripts/generate-daily-brief.py. Find the block that writes docs/strategic-context.md (search for 'strategic-context' or 'strategic_output'). Wrap the entire write block in a conditional: only write IF the file does not exist OR a --force-strategic CLI flag is passed. Steps: (1) At top of file after imports, add: FORCE_STRATEGIC = '--force-strategic' in sys.argv. (2) Find the function that generates strategic-context.md content (look for 'strategic_output' or 'STRATEGIC_OUTPUT' variable). (3) Find the open()/write() call that writes to docs/strategic-context.md. (4) Wrap that write call: if FORCE_STRATEGIC or not os.path.exists(strategic_output_path): [write the file] else: print('strategic-context.md exists — skipping (use --force-strategic to overwrite)'). (5) Do NOT change any other behavior — daily-brief.md and gate-tracker.md must still generate normally. FAIL IF: strategic-context.md is still overwritten when it already exists and --force-strategic is not passed. PASS IF: existing strategic-context.md is preserved on normal run, overwritten only with --force-strategic.
tasks.context: generate-daily-brief.py overwrites docs/strategic-context.md on every run (daily cron at 06:55). Sprint 101 task 101-03 had to manually restore it. The curated version has 96 lines (9-layer architecture, kill switches, Phase 1 status). The template version has 42 generic lines. Fix: skip write if file exists unless --force-strategic flag is passed.

tasks.title: Create end-to-end pipeline smoke test — validate all 12 stages in mock mode
tasks.description: CREATE ONE NEW FILE: scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.ts. DO NOT modify any existing file. EXACT IMPLEMENTATION: (1) imports at top: import { SCS001Orchestrator, PipelineRunReport } from '../agents/scs001-orchestrator/index'; import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync } from 'fs'; import { join } from 'path'; (2) async main() function: const orch = new SCS001Orchestrator('mock'); const report: PipelineRunReport = await orch.run(); (3) Validate: const errorStages = report.stages.filter(s => s.status === 'error'); const stageCount = report.stages.length; const s = report.summary; const criticalCounters = [s.topics_found, s.clips_discovered, s.insights_generated, s.scripts_produced, s.videos_edited, s.videos_captioned, s.qc_passed + s.qc_failed]; const zeroCounters = criticalCounters.filter(c => c === 0); (4) Build result: const passed = errorStages.length === 0 && stageCount >= 8 && zeroCounters.length === 0; (5) Write report: const reportsDir = join(process.cwd(), 'reports'); if (!existsSync(reportsDir)) mkdirSync(reportsDir, { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(reportsDir, 'smoke-test-latest.json'), JSON.stringify({ passed, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), stage_count: stageCount, error_count: errorStages.length, zero_counters: zeroCounters.length, summary: report.summary, errors: errorStages.map(e => e.stage + ': ' + (e.error ?? 'unknown')) }, null, 2)); (6) Print and exit: console.log(''); console.log(passed ? 'SMOKE TEST PASS' : 'SMOKE TEST FAIL'); if (errorStages.length > 0) errorStages.forEach(e => console.log('  ERROR: ' + e.stage + ' — ' + (e.error ?? ''))); if (zeroCounters.length > 0) console.log('  WARNING: ' + zeroCounters.length + ' critical counters are zero'); console.log('  Stages: ' + stageCount + ' | Errors: ' + errorStages.length + ' | Report: reports/smoke-test-latest.json'); process.exit(passed ? 0 : 1); (7) Bottom: main().catch(e => { console.error('SMOKE TEST ERROR:', e.message); process.exit(1); }); FAIL IF: file not created, does not exit 1 on failure, does not write reports/smoke-test-latest.json, imports anything other than orchestrator/fs/path.
tasks.context: No end-to-end test exists for the 12-stage SCS-001 pipeline. Only smoke-test-event-bus.ts exists (tests Supabase event bus only). Pipeline runs 4x daily via PM2. Regressions go undetected. SCS001Orchestrator supports mock mode (no API calls). PipelineRunReport has: stages[] with status: 'ok'|'partial'|'empty'|'error', and summary with topics_found, clips_discovered, insights_generated, scripts_produced, videos_edited, videos_captioned, qc_passed, qc_failed.

tasks.title: Create smoke-test-pipeline.sh — bash wrapper for operator pipeline validation
tasks.description:
CREATE ONE NEW FILE: scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.sh. DO NOT modify any existing file. EXACT CONTENT (write exactly this): #!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
PROJECT_ROOT=$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

echo 'SCS-001 Pipeline Smoke Test'
echo '==========================='
echo ''

npx ts-node scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.ts
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo ''
if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'Pipeline smoke test PASSED'
else
  echo 'Pipeline smoke test FAILED (exit '$EXIT_CODE')'
fi

exit $EXIT_CODE

After creating the file, make it executable with chmod +x scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.sh. FAIL IF: file not created, not executable, does not propagate ts-node exit code, modifies any existing file.
tasks.context: Operator needs a single command to validate pipeline before go-live. Follows pattern of run-live.sh (bash wrapper). The TS file does validation; bash handles project root navigation and human-readable output.
